title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Edits
abstract: arXiv:2608.15138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing an ABR algorithm for one network scenario takes an engineer months, and large language models now do this work in hours, matching or beating hand-built designs. But either way, the design fits only the world visible at its birth, and fails on the world that arrives after. We ask whether an ABR algorithm can keep pace with the world, redesigned in minutes as each scenario arrives, with every change proven harmless to every scenario already served. In this work, we propose ReForge, a continual heuristic learning framework that adapts to continuously changing scenarios. ReForge runs that routine with a large language model (LLM) in the loop. Each round the LLM reads where the current design falls short and proposes one small edit, and a replay over every network served so far decides. translated_title: ReForge：通过验证的大型语言模型编辑使ABR算法永不停滞
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15138v1 公告类型：新 摘要：为一个网络场景设计自适应比特率（ABR）算法需要工程师数月时间，而大型语言模型现在能在数小时内完成这项工作，其性能可媲美或超越手工设计。然而，无论哪种方式，设计仅适应于其诞生时可见的世界，而无法应对之后出现的新世界。我们提出一个问题：ABR算法能否跟上世界的步伐，在每次新场景出现时于几分钟内重新设计，并确保每次更改对已服务的所有场景均证明无害。在本工作中，我们提出ReForge，一种持续启发式学习框架，用于适应不断变化的场景。ReForge将大型语言模型（LLM）纳入循环中运行该流程。每轮中，LLM读取当前设计的不足之处并提出一个小编辑，然后通过对所有已服务网络的回放来决定是否采纳。具体而言，其编辑对象是一页模糊规则，该规则将每个决策路由至一组冻结的预训练策略池中。LLM编写...
tldr: ReForge利用大型语言模型循环持续重新设计ABR算法，通过验证每个小编辑对历史场景的无害性，实现算法对不断变化网络场景的分钟级适应。
en_tdlr: ReForge leverages a large language model in the loop to continuously redesign ABR algorithms, adapting to evolving network scenarios within minutes by verifying each small edit's harmlessness to all previously served scenarios.
